description:
Medicago truncatula Tnt1 retrotransposon insertion lines (Noble/OSU collection, ~22,000 R108 lines, flanking
sequence tags placed on Mt4.0): by gene, the lines with an insertion in the gene's CDS, UTR, intron or <= 1 kb
promoter, with the line's recorded phenotype; by phenotype (words in the line description, e.g. 'nod-',
'dwarf', 'leaf'), the lines and the genes their insertions hit. gene: Mt4.0 ID (Medtr4g104370), an
MtrunA17 (v5) or R108 ID (mapped through LIS pangenes), or another legume gene (pea Psat..., soybean Glyma...,
chickpea, lentil; mapped to Medicago genes of the same LIS legume gene family, which is broad). For pea genes,
the pea TILLING resource (UTILLdb) is given as a link-out.
name: medicago_tnt1_lines
